name: xprs_nrf52
description: What every XPRS station on an nRF52840 shares (Adafruit nRF52 Arduino core): the key and callsign, the boot ordinal, the config file, the clock, signing, and the signed firmware update with its RAM copier, the hardware AES block the LoRa networks need (nrf_aes.cpp), and who the station hears with what Bluetooth may hand to LoRa (nrf_hears.cpp). Used by models/sensecap-p1-pro and models/sensecap-t1000e.
